eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 无账号 · 一条命令

headline.zh:
vibe-code 出来的应用能不能用
一条命令给你红黄绿判定
headline.en:
Can your vibe-coded app actually run?
One command, a traffic-light verdict

sub.zh: 三个纯模块替你跑完三道专业门槛——干净环境能不能跑、算不算生产可用、许可证干不干净；汇总成一个双语判定，不用装 Docker、不用懂技术。
sub.en: Three pure modules clear three expertise gauntlets for you — does it run in a clean env, is it production-ready, is the license clean — and roll them into one bilingual verdict. No Docker, no expertise needed.

title.en: A real run, in a clean env

body.zh: 把项目复制进临时沙箱、全新装一遍依赖、30 秒超时跑一次启动，真正抓到崩溃还是能跑起来。诊断诚实到层级：装依赖卡住（多半是网络慢）和应用自己启动超时，分开报；小游戏项目也被认出来，不会被误判成“没启动脚本”白扣一盏灯。不是看代码猜，是实跑一次。
body.en: Copies your project into a temp sandbox, installs dependencies fresh, then launches the app under a 30-second timeout to actually catch a crash or a clean start. The diagnosis is honest by layer: a dependency install that hung (usually a slow network) is reported separately from an app whose own start timed out — and mini-game projects are recognized for what they are, not mis-blamed as “no start script” and docked a light they don’t deserve. Not reading code and guessing — a real run.

chips: › 临时沙箱 · 全新装依赖
› 装依赖 / 启动超时·分开报

title.zh: 许可证 / 版权，红黄绿一句话

body.zh: 枚举依赖的许可证并自动分级：GPL / AGPL 直接判红、LGPL / MPL 判黄，再嗅探代码里的版权头有没有被抹掉。不用你会读 SPDX 表。
body.en: Enumerates dependency licenses and auto-grades them — GPL / AGPL flag red, LGPL / MPL flag yellow — and sniffs whether copyright headers were stripped from the code. No need to read an SPDX table.

title.zh: 生产可用，先静态扫一遍

body.zh: 跑之前先扫就绪信号：缺 README、没锁文件、把 node_modules 真提交进库、没有 .gitignore、硬编码密钥、生产路径残留 console.log——这些一看就是还没法上线的痕迹。判断更诚实：本地装着但已 gitignore 的 node_modules 只提醒不判红，测试里的 console.log 不再误报，连大写变量名的密钥也抓得到。
body.en: Before running, sweep for readiness signals: missing README, no lockfile, node_modules genuinely committed, no .gitignore, hardcoded secrets, console.log left in production paths — the tell-tale signs it isn't shippable yet. The verdict is honest: a locally-installed but gitignored node_modules only warns (no false red), console.log in test files is ignored, and even uppercase or mixed-case key names get caught.

title.zh: 非开发者读得懂 · 不用账号
title.en: A non-dev can read it · no account

body.zh: 三个模块汇成一个双语红黄绿判定，既是终端里一眼看懂的结论，也是机器可读的 JSON 报告。本地跑完，无云、无账号、无守护进程。
body.en: The three modules roll into one bilingual traffic-light verdict — both a one-glance terminal conclusion and a machine-readable JSON report. Runs locally: no cloud, no account, no daemon.

headline.zh: 三道专业门槛，压成一条本地命令
headline.en: Three expertise gauntlets, one local command

sub.zh: 开源、MIT。本地判定这一核心动作，永不设墙；托管徽章是可选的后续。
sub.en: Open source, MIT. The core act of a local verdict is never gated; a hosted badge is an optional later step.

tag.zh: 给 vibe-code 出来的应用放行的本地闸门
tag.en: The local gate that ships vibe-coded apps
